instruction: How to set up Crossplane with AWS provider for S3
output: kubectl apply -f provider-aws-s3.yaml

instruction: How to create a Crossplane S3 bucket with versioning
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: s3.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: my-versioned-bucket
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    versioningConfiguration:
      status: Enabled
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane S3 bucket with encryption
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: s3.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: my-encrypted-bucket
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
      rules:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane S3 bucket with public access block
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: s3.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: my-secure-bucket
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
      blockPublicAcls: true
      blockPublicPolicy: true
      ignorePublicAcls: true
      restrictPublicBuckets: true
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane RDS instance with PostgreSQL
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: rds.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: DBInstance
metadata:
  name: my-postgres
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    dbInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
    masterUsername: admin
    masterUserPasswordSecretRef:
      name: rds-pass
      namespace: default
      key: password
    engine: postgres
    engineVersion: "14"
    allocatedStorage: 20
    skipFinalSnapshot: true
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane RDS instance with MySQL
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: rds.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: DBInstance
metadata:
  name: my-mysql
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    dbInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
    masterUsername: admin
    masterUserPasswordSecretRef:
      name: rds-pass
      namespace: default
      key: password
    engine: mysql
    engineVersion: "8.0"
    allocatedStorage: 20
    skipFinalSnapshot: true
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane IAM user
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: iam.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: IAMUser
metadata:
  name: my-user
spec:
  forProvider:
    path: /system/
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane IAM access key
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: iam.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: IAMAccessKey
metadata:
  name: my-access-key
spec:
  forProvider:
    userNameRef:
      name: my-user
  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: my-user-creds
    namespace: default
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane IAM policy
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: iam.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: IAMPolicy
metadata:
  name: my-policy
spec:
  forProvider:
    name: my-policy
    description: My custom policy
    policyDocument: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [{
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": "s3:GetObject",
          "Resource": "*"
        }]
      }
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane IAM role
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: iam.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: IAMRole
metadata:
  name: my-role
spec:
  forProvider:
    name: my-role
    assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [{
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": {"Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com"},
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
        }]
      }
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane VPC
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: ec2.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: VPC
metadata:
  name: my-vpc
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    cidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
    enableDnsSupport: true
    enableDnsHostnames: true
    instanceTenancy: default
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane subnet
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: ec2.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Subnet
metadata:
  name: my-subnet
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    availabilityZone: us-east-1a
    cidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
    vpcIdRef:
      name: my-vpc
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane security group
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: ec2.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: SecurityGroup
metadata:
  name: my-sg
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    groupName: my-sg
    description: My security group
    vpcIdRef:
      name: my-vpc
    ingress:
    - fromPort: 443
      toPort: 443
      ipProtocol: tcp
      ipRanges:
      - cidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane EKS cluster
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: eks.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: my-eks
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    name: my-eks-cluster
    roleArnRef:
      name: eks-role
    resourcesVpcConfig:
      subnetIdRefs:
      - name: my-subnet-1
      - name: my-subnet-2
      endpointPublicAccess: true
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane EKS node group
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: eks.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: NodeGroup
metadata:
  name: my-nodegroup
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    clusterNameRef:
      name: my-eks
    nodeRoleArnRef:
      name: node-role
    scalingConfig:
      minSize: 2
      maxSize: 5
      desiredSize: 2
    subnetIdRefs:
    - name: my-subnet-1
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane IAM instance profile
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: iam.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: InstanceProfile
metadata:
  name: my-instance-profile
spec:
  forProvider:
    name: my-instance-profile
    path: /
    roles:
    - roleName: my-role
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane ECR repository
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: ecr.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Repository
metadata:
  name: my-ecr-repo
spec:
  forProvider:
    repositoryName: my-app
    imageTagMutability: MUTABLE
    imageScanningConfiguration:
      scanOnPush: true
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane CloudWatch log group
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: cloudwatch.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: LogGroup
metadata:
  name: my-log-group
spec:
  forProvider:
    logGroupName: /aws/my-app
    retentionInDays: 30
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane SNS topic
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: sns.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Topic
metadata:
  name: my-topic
spec:
  forProvider:
    topicName: my-app-alerts
    region: us-east-1
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane SQS queue
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: sqs.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Queue
metadata:
  name: my-queue
spec:
  forProvider:
    queueName: my-app-queue
    region: us-east-1
    visibilityTimeout: 30
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crosspose DynamoDB table
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: dynamodb.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Table
metadata:
  name: my-table
spec:
  forProvider:
    tableName: my-app-table
    attributeDefinitions:
    - attributeName: id
      attributeType: S
    keySchema:
    - attributeName: id
      keyType: HASH
    billingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
    region: us-east-1
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane Lambda function
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: lambda.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: my-function
spec:
  forProvider:
    functionName: my-app-function
    runtime: python3.9
    handler: index.handler
    role: arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/lambda-role
    code:
      s3Bucket: my-code-bucket
      s3Key: function.zip
    region: us-east-1
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane ElastiCache cluster
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: elasticache.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: CacheCluster
metadata:
  name: my-cache
spec:
  forProvider:
    cacheClusterId: my-redis
    cacheNodeType: cache.t3.micro
    engine: redis
    numCacheNodes: 1
    engineVersion: "7.0"
    region: us-east-1
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane Route53 hosted zone
output:

kind: HostedZone
metadata:
  name: my-zone
